"}, {"insert": "Jonathan Rhyne从很小就是技术爱好者和计算机爱好者，对电脑游戏感兴趣。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这让他本科开始学计算机科学，很快决定不想整天独自坐在电脑前解 puzzle。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他想做点更面向人的、需要软技能和社交技能的。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 pivot 到法学院，毕业，在2008-2009金融危机前后执业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那是找工作的 tough 时期，所以他决定自己开业，给软件工程师提供财务建议，尤其是 indie 软件开发者，随着iOS SDK发布和移动革命开始。"}, {"insert": "

"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从那里，他加入PS PDF Kit，一个iOS SDK，旨在解决在iPhone上放杂志app的问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们继续 scale，在Android和最终 web 上建SDK，主要围绕PDF查看和文档处理。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们 scale 这公司7年， bootstrap 直到2021年，那时Insight Partners这家VC私募股权公司收购了他们。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那时点，他继续 scale 公司，现在叫Nutrient.io。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "ARR高八位数，可持续 scale。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "过去四年ARR翻了四倍。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "找到团队"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": {"image": "https://images.indiehackers.com/team-images/jonathan-rhyne-founder.jpg"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他被和来自世界各地的人远程工作的想法激励，这些人高度 motivated 创新、改变软件和技术现状。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "法律行业不是最创新或进步的行业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "作为律师，他不断处理数字文档，遇到很多挫折和痛苦。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他不断问自己："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": ""个人计算随着手机和iPhone的引入改变了这么多，为什么我们还用1990年代和2000年代初的相同数字文档格式？"", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当他遇到Peter和Martin时，他找到两个非常技术型的联合创始人，高度 motivated、对工作产品标准很高。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "欧洲 great 技术联合创始人+他在美国的技术背景的组合，结合他的软技能和商业头脑，创造了 great match，产生了 great 结果。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "运气"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们很幸运 stumble upon 最初的产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Peter originally 收到一份咨询合同，同时等去加州硅谷一家创业公司工作。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "合同涉及在iPhone上放杂志app。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "数字文档空间没人认为移动会成气候。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "因此，没有框架或工具供开发者处理看似简单的问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们建了UI，把Apple的PDFKit从macOS port 过来，那时iOS还不可用。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们最终 ship 了原始SDK，帮人们查看、注释、填写PDF表单。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他说他们幸运，因为他们从第一天就解决了一个非常紧迫的iOS需求。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "很多大公司在移动上投资，面临开源不容易解决或处理的问题。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "从第一天就有需求。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "而且，Peter和他都来自iOS空间，在 tight-knit 的 indie 开发者社区有品牌认知。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "三管齐下商业模式"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Nutrient，他们旨在进化人类如何互动和体验文档。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "目前在开发开发者工具如SDK，处理文档任务：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "文档文件类型转换", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "文档生成", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "文档理解", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "文档查看", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "签署", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "表单填写", "attributes": {"list": "bullet"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "都帮企业替代纸张、驱动数字化转型、进化数字文档体验。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们有三条业务线：", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SDK和Cloud API，专门为软件工程师集成和构建，当他们的应用有文档相关需求或功能时", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SharePoint和Salesforce的市场集成，解决文档需求如签署、数据提取、转换、生成，这些平台自己 underserve，尽管很多企业在这些平台上建文档工作流", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "自己的工作流自动化平台，面向有复杂工作流、需要高合规、可审计性、安全的企业", "attributes": {"list": "ordered"}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "大部分产品用 bespoke 销售驱动模式。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们用这个方式因为他们卖给企业包括IBM、美国政府、很多知名科技公司，以及创业公司、中小市场公司等。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "产品价值基于客户怎么用、使用规模、对其运营的重要性而变。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们通过卖更多产品给这些大企业和上中市场公司增长收入，因为需求跨越多条产品线，而且他们经常 prefer 一个供应商处理所有文档相关需求。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "广泛技术栈"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "作为开发者工具公司，他们用大量语言和框架。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "真正的问题是："什么不是他们技术栈的一部分？""}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们主要用Linux和macOS。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "SDK核心，他们有C++ monorepo renderer和C#/.NET图像、PDF解析器、OCR引擎。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "移动端，他们用Objective-C、Swift、SwiftUI集成monorepo到iOS，Android用Java和Kotlin。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也用Flutter（Dart）和React Native等混合框架。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Web端，主要用JavaScript、React、TypeScript，但也支持很多其他JavaScript框架集成。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们提供 standalone 客户端Wasm Web SDK和Elixir服务器及微服务部署，用于服务器端渲染和文档处理。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "工作流自动化平台主要用JavaScript。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最近把营销和文档网站迁移到Astro。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用Ruby建了内部许可、开票、指标应用。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "口碑"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期，他们通过为社区做贡献吸引用户。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "意思是做开源，意思是写内容，尤其当他们发现对其他iOS开发者有用的东西时。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后给他们看产品。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但 crucially，他们让用户发现价值，而不只是告诉他们价值。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "随他们 scale，那些用户讲他们的故事，用他们自己的话分享产品价值，帮了很多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "用户能比企业直接说更 resonate 其他用户地表达价值。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "现在，他们通过付费广告、合作伙伴、系统集成商、会议吸引企业。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但早期，仍然驱动他们大部分漏斗顶部的，是口碑推荐和自然流量。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "规模化时保持文化"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他做这行12年了，每个阶段都面临重大挑战。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但他克服的最大障碍可能是2021年以来的最近一次 scale 努力，那时投资者加入。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "随他们成长，开始从不同组织、不同 growth 路径和流程招外部经理。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "保持建公司的文化同时允许它进化，同时从3人 scale 到15人、50人、然后170人，很有挑战。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他发现待在 weeds 里 crucial。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他 try 尽可能贴近客户痛点和体验，以及从产品onboarding到使用的全过程。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但随你成长、管理职责增加，这变得更难。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你会产生一种不需要待在 weeds 里的 false sense。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "人事管理也变难。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你小一点的时候，更容易知道谁表现好、谁 committed、谁不是。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "也清楚谁不符合你的文化。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你得理解："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有些人会 outgrow 你的组织，move 到更大的，这 okay 且有益。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "有些人组织内 growth 不够或不够快，虽然感觉不好，但也 okay 且正常。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "作为创始人 emotional 处理这个极其 taxing。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "设定期望"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他发现人类，尤其是你管理的，想要确定性。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他们想要对期望的清晰——什么 lead 成功、什么 lead 失败。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "规模化时，tendency 是因害怕分歧、离开、或被认为负面而避免 state 期望。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这最终导致 withhold 信息和 poor 沟通，结果是大惊喜和 worse 结果。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他发现 clarify 期望 much better。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "那允许人们 self-select out，理想尽快，让你能快速识别和组织期望 aligned 的同事。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "巨人的肩膀"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他发现从面临相似情况的其他人那里读和学特别 helpful。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这里有几个 stuck with 他的例子："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Jeff Bezos", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "，早期Amazon年度股东报告里讨论第一类和第二类决策：可逆和不可逆的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他解释，随组织 scale，tendency 是把用于不可逆决策的相同系统——涉及 stakeholders、规划、会议——用于可逆决策。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "这最终导致缓慢和缺乏创新。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Steve Jobs", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "，回到Apple后，学会对同事采取更长远的观点。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "早期，如果他看到问题，立刻 fix 它。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他学会有时你需要建一个系统让同事自己发现问题，而不是立刻解决。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Snowflake前CEO", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "强调经理需要不断 push urgency。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他解释，没有经理 push urgency，团队自然变得和DMV一样慢和 dysfunctional。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他还指出每天不断 push urgency emotional taxing，但这是在高度竞争市场中竞争和前进的唯一方式。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "渴求批判性反馈"}, {"insert": "
", "attributes": {"header": 2}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "他的建议："}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "别陷入产品比分发重要的争论。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "两者同等重要，不幸的是，good enough 产品的 great 分发几乎总是战胜 great 产品的 okay 分发。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "就是说，他见过的大多数软件工程师，当遇到分发问题时，double down 功能开发和 building，因为那是他们懂的。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Fight confirmation bias。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "过去12年里，从"我不知道"开始帮他最多。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "当你真相信你懂的时候这 very hard。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "但这意味着你搜索，不是为了 validate 你认为你知道的，而是为了 invalidate 它。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你变得非常渴求负面、批判性反馈。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你把这种负面、批判性反馈看作礼物，因为它是帮你改进的反馈回路。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你越快得到这反馈，越快能基于它行动并改进，越接近成功。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "和你 prospective 客户聊，了解他们的痛点，了解他们告诉你的背后的真正问题。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "然后，足够 care 解决它的细节，用小事让他们惊叹。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Great 产品不是一件 grand 功能或 blow people away 的东西。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "它几乎总是一路上的 tiny moments of joy。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "学会 okay with risk。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "停止通过结果概率的镜头看 risk。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "开始通过成本 vs 潜在 upside 的镜头看 risk。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "寻找不对称 upside，你会找到你应该喜欢 taking 的风险。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "最后，别害怕失败。", "attributes": {"bold": true}}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "失败只是通往成功的路。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "你越早把失败看作学习机会，越快在成功之路上前进。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Luck 涉及，但通常只向那些 put in effort 的人展示自己。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "Effort 不 guarantee 成功，但如果你不 put in effort，你没有成功 chance。"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "
"}, {"insert": "**"}]}
content_en:
From Mobile SDK to 8-Figure ARR Portfolio

Jonathan Rhyne was a tech enthusiast and computer buff from a young age, interested in computer games.

This led him to start studying computer science in college, but quickly decided he didn't want to spend all day sitting alone in front of a computer solving puzzles.

He wanted something more people-oriented, requiring soft skills and social skills.

He pivoted to law school, graduated, and practiced around the 2008-2009 financial crisis.

It was a tough time to find a job, so he decided to open his own practice, providing financial advice to software engineers, especially indie software developers, as the iOS SDK was released and mobile revolution began.

He earned the reputation as the "iPhone lawyer Guy" in North America, then met co-founder + business partner Peter Steinberger at a conference called NSConf.

From there, he joined PS PDF Kit, an iOS SDK designed to solve the problem of putting magazine apps on iPhone.

They continued to scale, building SDKs on Android and eventually web, primarily around PDF viewing and document processing.

They scaled this company for 7 years, bootstrapped until 2021, when Insight Partners, a VC private equity firm, acquired them.

At that point, he continued scaling the business, eventually selling to the same private equity firm.

content_ar:
من حزمة تطوير الهاتف المحمول إلى محفظة ذات 8 أرقام من الإيرادات السنوية المتكررة

جوناثان راين كان متحمساً للتكنولوجيا ومحباً للكمبيوتر من سن مبكرة، مهتماً بألعاب الكمبيوتر.

هذا دفعه لدراسة علوم الحاسب في الكلية، لكنه قرر بسرعة أنه لا يريد قضاء اليوم كله جالساً أمام الكمبيوترsolve الاحجيات.

أريد شيئاً أكثرpeople-oriented، يتطلب مهارات ناعمة ومهارات اجتماعية.

تحول إلى كلية القانون، تخرج، ومارس حول أزمة 2008-2009 المالية.

كان وقتاً صعباً للعثور على وظيفة، لذلك قرر فتح ممارسته الخاصة، تقديم نصائح مالية لمهندسي البرمجيات، خاصة مطوري البرمجيات المستقلين، حيث تم إصدار iOS وبدأت ثورة الهاتف المحمول.

اكتسب سمعة "محامي الآيفون" في أمريكا الشمالية، ثم التقى المؤسس المشارك + شريك العمل بيتر شتاينبرغر في مؤتمر叫做 NSConf.

من هناك، انضم إلى PS PDF Kit، حزمة تطوير iOS مصممة لحل مشكلة وضع تطبيقات المجلة على الآيفون.

استمروا في التوسع، وبنوا حزم تطوير على أندروأخيراً الويب، أساساً حول عرض PDF ومعالجة المستندات.

وسعوا هذه الشركة لمدة 7 سنوات، بدون استثمار حتى 2021، عندما استحوذت عليها Insight Partners، شركة الأسهم الخاصة.

في تلك المرحلة، واصل توسيع العمل، وأخيراً باع لنفس شركة الأسهم الخاصة.
